Northwind Outfitters Refund and Returns Policy

Customers may return unused items within 30 days of delivery for a full reimbursement of the purchase price. The 30-day window starts on the date the parcel is marked as delivered by the carrier, not on the order date.

To start a return, open the order in your account and choose "Return items". You will receive a prepaid shipping label by email within one business day. Items must be sent back in their original packaging with all tags attached.

Refunds are issued to the original payment method. Card refunds usually appear within 5 to 7 business days after the warehouse inspects the returned goods. Store credit is issued immediately after inspection if you choose it instead.

Final-sale items, gift cards and personalised products cannot be returned. Shipping fees are non-refundable unless the item arrived damaged or the wrong item was sent.

If an item arrives damaged, contact support within 48 hours with photos of the damage and the packaging. Damaged items are replaced free of charge or refunded in full including shipping.
